name: coregrid
description: CoreGrid — The Autonomous Enterprise System. A full-stack AI-native ERP (HR, CRM, Inventory, Finance, Projects) with private on-device AI. Runs standalone for instant demos.

paragraphs: One intelligent grid for HR, CRM, Inventory, Finance & Projects — with private, on-device AI.
Live Demo · Features · Architecture · Quick Start · Deploy

CoreGrid is a full-stack, production-grade Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) platform that unifies a company's core operations into a single, calm workspace. It pairs a deeply relational data model (30+ entities) with role-based access control, live cross-module analytics, and privacy-first AI that runs locally through Ollama — so sensitive business data never leaves your infrastructure.
features: 🛰️ Standalone Demo Mode — runs anywhere (including Vercel) with zero backend. A realistic sample company is served from an in-memory, Prisma-compatible engine so you can explore the entire product instantly.
🏢 Full Mode — backed by PostgreSQL, NextAuth and Ollama for real deployments.
🤖 Private AI — local LLM analysis for HR, finance, inventory, sales & projects; AI email drafting and resume parsing. Nothing is sent to a third party.
🔐 RBAC — seven roles (Admin, HR, Sales, Inventory, Finance, Project Manager, Employee) enforced in middleware and on the server.
🧾 Audit logging — every critical action recorded.
